incoming_method: portal inflow, production-weighted: the same units produced last season at ANOTHER programme by players on this roster now, over this programme’s own last-season total (misses FCS/JUCO arrivals and players who did not play)
method: share of last season’s countable production for this programme (dropbacks 1, touches 1, targets 0.5, defensive events 1; research/features_roster.py) made by players on its roster now
qb_method: prev_primary_qb_id = the athlete with the most dropbacks for this programme last season; returning_qb = he is on the roster now
source: cfbfastR-data player_stats 2025 (production units, team as attributed by the play feed) x EdgeDesk ESPN roster sync 2026 (athlete ids)
